review.title: DCPP consortium: two distinct Sphingopyxis stock genus-reference correspondences
review.independence_basis: Parent independently read the primary-source context, authored source config, complete native results, full candidate diff and external candidate/receipt hashes before the guarded M5 application. The shared source binder, engine, native gate runner and review builder were independently reviewed with mutation controls. This is self-review of the resulting bounded technical correction.
review.summary: The distinct DBS4 and DCP-4 taxonomy occurrences now carry native Sphingopyxis genus-reference correspondences and grounding statuses. Their stock identities, genus-only scientific scope, existing Achromobacter DCP-11d correspondence, all biological claims, quotations and old history remain unchanged. Actual M5 application, append-only sidecar and eight scoped native commands are bound separately.
review.scope_description: Exactly two declared genus-reference blocks/statuses, two actual native inline events and the source/application/validation provenance for CommunityMech:000410. This partial technical diagnostic does not assess all scientific assertions or identify the experimental stocks with reference genomes.
review.selection: One whole-record canary, CommunityMech:000410, selected from the separately source-prepared nine-record higher-rank batch. Only its two Sphingopyxis taxonomy occurrences are changed. The other eight records have not been applied by this canary, and nine-record selection context is not the reviewed population.
limitations: Partial technical diagnostic with scientific_review:false. Scoped completion is not full scientific review, source-snippet validation, generated-page integration, final corpus QC or completion of the repair campaign.

Each79/79 result is the same named-binomial reference population under crosswalk761d5537, not79 genomes from DBS4 or DCP-4 and not independent stock-genome evidence. The exact study-stock species and assemblies remain unassigned.

Primary evidence is the retained PMID42613016 abstract and selected PMC13485441 main-text passages. This bounded pass performs no new complete-paper, supplement, figure-pixel, strain-sequence or assembly audit.

The source distinguishes five screened isolates from the selected three-member consortium. DBS4 and DCP-4 remain separate Sphingopyxis stocks, and Achromobacter DCP-11d remains an unchanged third member with its prior correspondence.

Modeled exchange and measured metabolite or inhibition evidence remain distinct. D-glucosamine was not detected; liquid30mg/L and soil5mg/kg conditions are not interchangeable. No traced-flux, quantitative cross-feeding contribution or complete-mineralization claim is added. Existing issue596 and historical needs_research findings remain open.

Native route reporting ran locally at0e826fcf, source binding at4c0046c6 and staging/actual M5 application/checks at e83c687c56beb7160be20a0db2439dab92cfdb67. Local native Python was3.13.12 and M5 native Python3.13.2. Post-application checks are not a clean-tree run. File mtime in mapping_source is not a database release. Local NCBI identity/rank observations are stat-bound rather than a full database checksum.

The first nine-record source-binding attempt refused an incorrectly joined literal newline in record440 under issue2878; that unchanged failed attempt remains separate. The corrected source config passed a fresh410 binding canary before the full source-only nine-record binding. No failed binding is counted as an application or validation pass.
